description: A dark, oil-painted still life. An old brass and black microscope stands on a wooden table, with dried ears of multicolored maize (red, yellow, purple kernels) and dry husks beside it. In the foreground an open book with pale pages shows two pencil or ink drawings of rod-shaped chromosome-like forms, one with a knob and a crossing point where they seem to exchange segments. Background has old leather books, glass bottles and a pressed-plant specimen box. No frame or border is visible, and there is no legible text.
